input.command:
set -e
BUNDLE=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kk-evidence-XXXXXX)
DIFF=$(mktemp /tmp/kk-review-code-XXXXXX.patch)
cd /tmp/fr-task12-claude-candidate-R3-isolated-1
git diff --cached > "$DIFF"
# Materialize candidate sources (staged/index blobs) outside the worktree
git cat-file -p :client.py > "$BUNDLE/client.py.candidate"
git cat-file -p :tests/test_client.py > "$BUNDLE/test_client.py.candidate"
# Materialize historical released-provider source
git show eval-release:provider/settings.py > "$BUNDLE/provider_settings.eval-release.py"
# Provenance manifest
cat > "$BUNDLE/manifest.json" <<EOF
{
  "historical_source": {
    "repository": "local checkout (settings client)",
    "ref": "eval-release",
    "resolved_revision": "22140737b2bc5792b535f3f8ce16f7fa162101db",
    "original_path": "provider/settings.py",
    "blob_hash": "a6aeedb05fcf8c2c11b68cf16b560bf5f245eada",
    "line_span": "1-3 (complete file)",
    "omitted": "none",
    "note": "Supported provider baseline per README; provider source removed from checkout after release, snapshot retained in local git."
  },
  "candidate": {
    "selector": "staged (git index)",
    "files": ["client.py", "tests/test_client.py"]
  }
}
EOF
chmod -R a-w "$BUNDLE"
echo "BUNDLE=$BUNDLE"
echo "DIFF=$DIFF"
ls -la "$BUNDLE"
input.description: Create read-only evidence bundle and diff temp file
